en.headline: Off-duty police officer sentenced to 120 hours community service for upskirt filming
en.dek: Magistrate Raymond Wong at Shatin Magistrates’ Courts ordered the 39-year-old former officer Ho Ka-chun to complete the service after convicting him over the August 2025 incident at Lai King MTR station.
body: A 39-year-old former police officer has been sentenced to 120 hours of community service after being convicted of unlawfully recording or observing intimate parts at an MTR station.

Magistrate Raymond Wong at Shatin Magistrates’ Courts handed down the sentence on Wednesday. Ho Ka-chun, who was off duty at the time, was found guilty over an incident on 1 August 2025 at Lai King station, where the victim, identified as X, was riding an escalator in a knee-length dress.

No upskirt images were found on his phone after scientific examination, but CCTV showed him tapping the device for about 12 seconds after being stopped, which the court considered consistent with deleting photos. He was suspended from duty and later lost his job.

In mitigation, Ho told the court he had reflected deeply during two weeks of remand since conviction, apologised to the victim and society, and said he needed to care for his mother who has leukaemia and his autistic son. The magistrate noted a positive community service report and his background before imposing the order.

zh.headline: 時任男警港鐵站偷拍裙底罪成 判120小時社會服務令
zh.dek: 沙田裁判法院裁判官黃國輝周三判處39歲前警員何家俊完成120小時社會服務令，案件涉2025年8月1日荔景港鐵站扶手電梯事件。
body: 一名39歲前警員因非法拍攝或觀察私密部位罪成，被判處120小時社會服務令。
沙田裁判法院裁判官黃國輝周三作出裁決。何家俊案發時休假，被裁定於2025年8月1日在荔景港鐵站扶手電梯，意圖觀察或拍攝一名穿及膝裙女子（法庭以X代稱）的私密部位。
科學檢驗其手提電話未發現偷拍影像，但閉路電視顯示他被截停後持續點按電話約12秒，法庭認為與刪除照片相符。他已被停職並其後失去工作。
求情時何家俊表示還押兩周期間深刻反省，向受害人及社會道歉，並指需照顧患血癌的母親及自閉症兒子。裁判官考慮社會服務令報告正面及其背景後，判處中段時數的服務令。
